title: FISURA — Reactivo-13
visual_style: Industrial science-fiction, PBR materials, readable over-shoulder framing and low-noise objective HUD
references: COD Mobile: responsive mobile movement and aim (design reference)
Gears of War: authored cover entry, cover strafing and contextual movement (design reference)
goals: Playable five-stage Reactivo-13 mission with consistent combat/cover and extraction
Mobile-first shoulder camera, legible tactical UI, independent multitouch movement/aim
Reproducible Godot 4.7.2 scenes and signed Android ARM64 debug APK
priorities: contextual cover with explicit physical colliders
readable HUD and mobile touch controls
scope: FISURA's production game remains in this repository. ARCONT is a separate reference/validator; do not embed the game into ARCONT.

performance.resolution: 1280x720 design baseline; adaptive device scaling requires measured evidence
performance.platform_notes: 60 fps is an aspirational target; Android device frame pacing and thermal performance are not yet measured.

constraints: Preserve Godot 4.7.2-stable and source-locked asset provenance
Never replace collision/navigation semantics with render-only assets
Do not claim AAA presentation or Android optimization without evidence
Stage changes on GitHub branches and run Godot/mission/Android CI before merge
Do not enable network asset acquisition or ARCONT project-write automatically
notes: Arcont 1.1 project-intent contract for external Godot authoring, sessions and MCP. The runtime still belongs to FISURA and CI remains authoritative.
